gate_failures_near_identical_income_view.definition: income-wire pairs with |8-cell mean difference| < 0.005, both orientations

gate_false_failure.assumptions: true income-view difference exactly 0 (curve: delta); normal noise; per-release split SD = sd_split / sqrt 2, reader-seed SD = sd_reader_seed / sqrt 2; candidate noise shared across its comparisons; seeds and repetitions independent (the R1 / R2 role sets overlap partly, which this ignores)
